name: structRFM
description: Structure-guided RNA foundation model pre-trained with Structure-guided Masked Language Modeling (SgMLM) on about 21 million RNA sequence-structure pairs, producing classification-level, sequence-level and pairwise matrix features. It has 768 hidden dimensions, 12 layers and 12 attention heads.

attributes.access: Code: GitHub repository https://github.com/heqin-zhu/structRFM and PyPI (structRFM). Pre-trained weights: Hugging Face heqin-zhu/structRFM, and GitHub release structRFM_checkpoint.tar.gz. Fine-tuned checkpoints and task data: Zenodo https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.16754363.
